notes.semetey-1-2013:p0542:b003:l010: Зарып interpreted contextual сарып/сарп spending wealth; initial consonant variant retained raw. Primary Yudakhin сарп кыл- расходовать supports sense.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0542:b003:l012: Мекедыл geographic form retained as Mekedyl; no unverified identification with Mecca. Төмөнкү retained lower, not silently distant.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0542:b003:l013: Eighty strongmen for burial account retained; the later five are treasure-cave workers, not silently corrected to the same number.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0542:b003:l014: аныктап taking assured care in concealed-burial context qualified; no embalming technique inserted.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0542:b004:l022: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0543:b003:l012: The slaves whose master died comparison characterizes the looters’ swagger, not an assertion that they were historically slaves. Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0543:b003:l021: кундуз = otter, not beaver; skins on trouser legs retained.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0543:b004:l005: Source enumerates six wicked half-brothers in pairs: Abyke/Kobosh, Chyiybyt/Kochkor, Adybai/Kolbai. No omission or external name substitution.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0543:b004:l014: Cauldron-sized turbans and call-to-prayer voices are explicit source images. Mosque poor/disabled inhabitants retained in ensuing verses.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0543:b004:l027: Source describes slaughter/destruction of religious occupants by the villains; translated without invented moderation or details.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0543:b004:l033: кереге lattice walls retained as source architecture; do not replace with stone walls based on expectations of a mosque.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0544:b003:l009: Not only living wife / even mosque and not only child / even garden are elliptical rhetorical parallels. English supplies only to make the inclusive force legible; no claim that Kanykei died here.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0544:b003:l014: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0544:b003:l018: мунар tower in destroyed mosque/garden setting; no mist dried away assertion. Primary Semetey1960 glossary373 мунара special tall building supports tower sense.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0544:b003:l020: God struck the uncles is the narrator’s condemnation of their deeds, not a newly narrated physical death of them.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0544:b003:l030: сары оору jaundice simile retained as literary image, not a medical diagnosis of Semetey.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0544:b004:l007: Five innocent dead workmen are explicitly named before following retrospective account; no omission of their deaths or speculative justification.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0544:b004:l010: Primary Yudakhin азыр III = назыр with exact example dedicating a light-gray mare at khan-father’s grave. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b003:l014: Five strongmen explicitly chosen from Argyn and Kyrgyz; distinct from eighty earlier burial workers.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b003:l021: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b003:l030: Daily horse wage and nightly gold ingot wage separately explicit; not combined into a single reward or inflation-adjusted value.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b003:l036: Fat lamb and choice heads retained as food; no omitted heads or invented fruit. Cooked fat in37 separately retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b005:l002: Primary Yudakhin мом II (или мом темир) see лом; exact мом темирлеп буздуруп cave-excavation quotation specifies iron crowbar. Render crowbars, not wax/soft iron.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b005:l004: сарамжал provisions/resources, eating during excavation. Does not mean the workers consumed literal tools or furniture.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b005:l011: Six thousand sheep is explicit cave-capacity hyperbole; no architectural estimate substituted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b005:l019: Seventy gelded pack camels remove spoil; eighty at34 move treasure. Distinct numbers preserved, not corrected to match.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b005:l024: Sand is dumped into the Talas to conceal the cave excavation as source narrative; no external instructions or engineering expansion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b005:l028: Friday holy night retained; no unsupported Ramadan calendar identification added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b005:l029: олоң long/thick hair per primary Semetey1960 glossary373, reinspected this batch; not a horse-girth comparison imposed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0545:b005:l032: Source wounded state retained, refers back to Kanykei’s injuries; no invented healing claim.
